model_output.rationale: Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing). However, the 277CA shows STC*A2:20 on 2025-01-27 — payer accepted the claim 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS. This is clearinghouse-acceptance proof of timely submission. CO-29 is incorrect; appeal disputing the receipt date with the 277CA. N211 on the MOA does not bar appeal on a commercial (CI) claim.

root_cause.explanation: Both lines carry CO-29. The 277CA (STC*A2:20*20250127) proves the claim was accepted by the payer 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS — well within any commercial filing window.

next_action.detail: File redetermination/first-level appeal with Liberty Bell Health Plans, attaching the 277CA acceptance report (STC*A2:20, 2025-01-27) as proof of timely receipt. Dispute the receipt date; do not plead forgiveness. N211 is a Medicare notice and does not bar commercial appeal.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*29*91.91 and CAS*CO*29*46.71 — both lines denied timely filing, group CO
STC*A2:20*20250127 — claim accepted for processing on 2025-01-27, 8 days after DOS
MOA N211 is a Medicare-only notice; payer is commercial (CI) — does not bar appeal

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute the receipt date
N211 applied in error in non-Medicare contexts (R3118CP); CO-29 redetermination is barred only on Medicare FFS
